title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with prices and contract terms. Compare gym memberships in Auckland city and suburbs.
intro: Aucklanders have a wide range of gym options to choose from, with prices starting from $15 per week. From budget-friendly options like Jetts Fitness to premium gyms like Les Mills, there's something for everyone. In this guide, we'll compare the best gyms in Auckland by suburb, price, and contract terms.

sections.heading: Top Gyms in Auckland CBD
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, with options like City Fitness, Les Mills, and Jetts Fitness. Prices vary, with City Fitness offering a 12-month contract for $32 per week, while Les Mills starts at $45 per week for a 6-month contract.

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms in Auckland
sections.body: For those who work in the city but live in the suburbs, a commuter gym can be a convenient option. Gyms like Jetts Fitness and Anytime Fitness have multiple locations throughout Auckland, including in the CBD and suburbs.

sections.heading: Gyms with Parking in Auckland

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: With so many gym options in Auckland, it's essential to compare prices and contract terms to find the best value for your money. Use our gym comparison tool to find the perfect gym for your needs and budget.
